name: 08873 · Somerset, NJ
findings: ZIP 08873 (Somerset) has 272 nonprofit organizations. 135 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 117 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08873 (Somerset) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08873 (Somerset) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 117 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
